Author: pokeda
Name: Harmonia
Punchline: Play Final Fantasy XIV in your language with community translations.
Description: Shows Final Fantasy XIV in another language using community translations. Add a translation from the link or file its author gives you, turn it on, and restart the game. Translations update themselves. /hfind finds what the game calls something you know by its original name. Characters the game's own fonts don't have, such as Cyrillic in window titles, need Penumbra.
